rotationRepresentation: 3x3 row matrices; column vectors; local matrix = inverse(parent bind world) × child bind world; matrices in FBX source length units

semantics.rawFbx: Only explicitly stored FBX transform properties. Euler angles in degrees; omitted properties use FBX defaults recorded in defaultLocalTRS. PreRotation and inverse PostRotation, pivots, rotation order and inheritance must be respected on import. defaultLocalTRS rotation alone is NOT effective rest orientation.
semantics.observedBindLocal: Inverse(parent bind matrix) × first observed child bind matrix. When bind is missing, full FBX default local transform composed under first observed bind parent; fallback is marked and is not verified against Blender. Conflicting world bind matrices are all preserved per bone; first observation is descriptive, not a canonical rest pose.
semantics.world: FBX column-major BindPose arrays transposed to row matrices; column vectors. World translations stay in source units. All files UnitScaleFactor=1 => cm; meters = value / 100. +Y up, +X coordinate axis, front axis metadata +Z. Front metadata alone is not proof mesh faces +Z.
semantics.poseScreen: Joint-position arm screen: both upper-arm→hand vectors within 10 degrees of XZ plane; both elbow bends <=10 degrees; hands opposed on X. This is a bind-skeleton screening result, not full rest/mesh T-pose validation.
semantics.defaultVsBind: Diagnostic max absolute component difference between simple hierarchical FBX-default matrices and first observed bind matrices. InheritType scale compensation is not fully evaluated; this diagnostic does not establish import correctness.
